title.en: Myself, each other, one and ones

rule.sl:
**myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves**: kdor dela, je tudi tisti, ki se mu zgodi: **I cut myself.** (Urezal sem se.) Slovenščina ima za vse *se*, angleščina eno obliko za vsako osebo. Ljudje rečejo tudi *hisself*, *theirselves*, na severu *meself*; pisava hoče **himself**, **themselves**, **myself**.

Ista beseda pove *sam*: **I did it myself.** **Mrs Birkett bakes the bread herself.**

Mnogi slovenski povratni glagoli je nimajo: **I feel tired.** (počutim se) **We met at the inn.** (srečali smo se) **I remember.** (spomnim se) **Sit down.** **Hurry up.** Ampak **enjoy** ga rabi: **Enjoy yourself!**

**on my own** in **by myself** pomenita sam, brez drugih: **Old Wilf lives on his own.**

**each other** je drug drugega: **Jack and Sam know each other.** (Poznata se.) **themselves** je vsak sebe: **They looked at themselves in the water.** Slovenski *se* je oboje.

**one**, **ones** stojita namesto znanega samostalnika: **the red one**, **the big ones**, **this one**, **a new one**.
rule.de:
**myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves**: Wer es tut, dem geschieht es auch: **I cut myself.** (Ich habe mich geschnitten.) Für *sich* gibt es eine Form je Person. Man sagt auch *hisself*, *theirselves*, im Norden *meself*; geschrieben steht **himself**, **themselves**, **myself**.

Dasselbe Wort sagt *selbst*: **I did it myself.** **Mrs Birkett bakes the bread herself.**

Viele deutsche reflexive Verben haben es nicht: **I feel tired.** (ich fühle mich) **We met at the inn.** (wir haben uns getroffen) **I remember.** (ich erinnere mich) **Sit down.** **Hurry up.** Aber **enjoy** braucht es: **Enjoy yourself!**

**on my own** und **by myself** heißen allein: **Old Wilf lives on his own.**

**each other** heißt einander: **Jack and Sam know each other.** (Sie kennen sich.) **themselves** heißt jeder sich selbst: **They looked at themselves in the water.** Deutsches *sich* ist beides.

**one**, **ones** stehen für ein bekanntes Nomen: **the red one** (den roten), **the big ones**, **this one**, **a new one**.
rule.it:
**myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves**: chi fa la cosa è anche chi la riceve: **I cut myself.** (Mi sono tagliat{m:o|f:a}.) Una forma per ogni persona. Si dice anche *hisself*, *theirselves*, al nord *meself*; per iscritto si usa **himself**, **themselves**, **myself**.

La stessa parola dice *da solo*: **I did it myself.** **Mrs Birkett bakes the bread herself.**

Molti riflessivi italiani non ce l'hanno: **I feel tired.** (mi sento) **We met at the inn.** (ci siamo incontrati) **I remember.** (mi ricordo) **Sit down.** **Hurry up.** Ma **enjoy** ne ha bisogno: **Enjoy yourself!**

**on my own** e **by myself** vogliono dire da solo: **Old Wilf lives on his own.**

**each other** vuol dire l'un l'altro: **Jack and Sam know each other.** (Si conoscono.) **themselves** è ognuno se stesso: **They looked at themselves in the water.** L'italiano *si* è tutti e due.

**one**, **ones** stanno per un nome già detto: **the red one** (quello rosso), **the big ones**, **this one**, **a new one**.
rule.en:
**myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves**: the one who does it is the one it happens to: **I cut myself.** One form for each person. People also say *hisself*, *theirselves*, and in the North *meself*; writing wants **himself**, **themselves**, **myself**.

The same word says with no help: **I did it myself.** **Mrs Birkett bakes the bread herself.**

Many verbs don't take it: **I feel tired.** **We met at the inn.** **I remember.** **Sit down.** **Hurry up.** But **enjoy** needs it: **Enjoy yourself!**

**on my own** and **by myself** say alone: **Old Wilf lives on his own.**

**each other** goes both ways: **Jack and Sam know each other.** **themselves** turns back on each: **They looked at themselves in the water.**

**one**, **ones** stand for a noun you've named: **the red one**, **the big ones**, **this one**, **a new one**.

rows: Old Wilf lives on his own.
Jack and Sam know each other.
the red one, the big ones

rule.sl: **I cut myself.** **I did it myself.** Brez njega: **I feel tired.** **We met.** Sam: **on my own**, **by myself**. Drug drugega: **each other**. Namesto samostalnika: **the red one**, **the big ones**.
rule.de: **I cut myself.** **I did it myself.** Ohne: **I feel tired.** **We met.** Allein: **on my own**, **by myself**. Einander: **each other**. Statt des Nomens: **the red one**, **the big ones**.
rule.it: **I cut myself.** **I did it myself.** Senza: **I feel tired.** **We met.** Da solo: **on my own**, **by myself**. L'un l'altro: **each other**. Al posto del nome: **the red one**, **the big ones**.
rule.en: **I cut myself.** **I did it myself.** Without it: **I feel tired.** **We met.** Alone: **on my own**, **by myself**. Both ways: **each other**. For a noun: **the red one**, **the big ones**.

examples.en: Jack and Sam know each other.

tip.sl: 💡 *se* je **himself** ali **each other**, pogosto pa nič: **I feel tired.**
tip.de: 💡 *sich* ist **himself** oder **each other**, oft auch nichts: **I feel tired.**
tip.it: 💡 *si* è **himself** o **each other**, spesso niente: **I feel tired.**
tip.en: 💡 **themselves** turns back; **each other** goes both ways.
